en.description:
A calm snake game — a journey across 12 living worlds on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Ride the wind, collect sundrops, and master each chapter at your own pace. No ads, no timers, no purchases.

FLOW & GLOW ON IPHONE AND IPAD
• Follow authored three-lane sundrop routes in Chapters 13–20 and build Flow chains
• See best Flow, sundrops, and close calls in your chapter recap
• Choose Gentle Current after three failed attempts: slightly slower, same campaign stars, unranked score
• Clear Daily Remixes on three days in a rolling week to earn a glowing trail — no consecutive streak needed
• Discover new Game Center milestones for Flow, exploration, and Remix mastery

YOUR JOURNEY
• 40 handcrafted chapters across 12 living worlds
• Daily Remix and a forgiving Daily Glow streak
• Earnable snake skins for perfecting a world
• Game Center leaderboards and achievements
• A full game on Apple Watch, with a Daily Glow complication
• iCloud sync for campaign progress across devices
• Colorblind palette and Reduce Motion support
• Offline gameplay, no ads, and no in-app purchases

The sun waits for you.
en.releaseNotes:
Find your Flow in Shadow Snakes!

• Follow new three-lane sundrop routes in Chapters 13–20, build Flow chains, and see your best Flow after each clear.
• Stuck on a chapter? Choose Gentle Current after three attempts for a slightly slower, unranked run with the same campaign stars.
• Clear Daily Remixes on three days in a week to earn a glowing trail. No consecutive streak required.
• Unlock eight new Game Center achievements for exploration, Flow, close calls, and Daily Remix mastery.
• Enjoy buffered lane taps, clearer feedback, and earlier obstacle warnings after repeated attempts.

New Flow & Glow features are available on iPhone and iPad.
en.subtitle: A calm, glowing arcade glide

versionHistory.releaseNotes: Version 3.6 gives every chapter a distinct layout and rhythm, with a smoother difficulty curve from a forgiving opening to the fastest finale. It also adds richer procedural audio, more natural hazards, improved photographic worlds, and independent Apple Watch play with Game Center support.
Game Center added, bugs fixed, gameplay improved, challenges introduced!
Bug fixes and a slew of updates!
Fixed game play bugs for a better expeirence!
Smoother gameplay across iPhone and iPad, with improved frame pacing and fewer audio-related hitches for a more responsive experience.
Improved gameplay smoothness and frame pacing across iPhone and iPad, plus fixes for Credits and Game Center access.

Version 5 introduces a new three-lane challenge beginning in Chapter 12. Tap above or below the snake to move one lane at a time, build Flow chains, earn near-miss bonuses, and move through chapters with fewer interruptions. New players now begin by playing immediately, retries are faster, and rank rules are consistent across iPhone and iPad.
